title: TheHive: Case Management for Incident Response
summary: Used TheHive to work through a queue of security cases: read case status and tags, followed a phishing case through its tasks, observables and attachments, checked evidence and ownership on other cases, and reviewed task status and dashboards.

title: DeepBlueCLI: Triaging Windows Event Logs
summary: Used DeepBlueCLI to triage sample Windows event logs: ran it against individual logs and then all of them at once, matched the detections to Event IDs and MITRE ATT&CK, and searched the combined output for indicators.

title: CMD and PowerShell: Hunting for Signs of Compromise
summary: Used basic Command Prompt and PowerShell commands on a Windows host to look for signs of compromise: exported the process list, reviewed local accounts and group membership, inspected running services and scheduled tasks, and picked out the items that did not belong.

title: Wireshark: Tracing an Attack in Packet Captures
summary: Analysed three packet captures in Wireshark: recognised host discovery and a port scan from the traffic pattern, recovered a file from HTTP traffic and hashed it, and read a clear-text FTP session to follow a dictionary attack and the file taken afterwards.

title: Splunk Investigation: Alert Triage with Dashboards
summary: Triaged IDS and firewall alerts from a prebuilt Splunk dashboard: read the queries behind the counters, drilled into individual alerts, checked the action taken and the response status to judge whether an attack worked, and pivoted from a firewall alert to the affected host in Sysmon.

title: Splunk Investigation: Tracing a Suspicious Executable
summary: Followed one suspicious executable across Sysmon, firewall and Suricata logs in Splunk: checked where the legitimate file should live, spotted the copy running from the wrong path, scoped its network connections, then confirmed what it was from its hash and the firewall classification.

title: Splunk Investigation: Scanner Activity in Firewall Logs
summary: Built a Splunk search layer by layer (sourcetype, domain, keyword) to find vulnerability-scanner activity in firewall logs, then pulled the scanner, the source and target IPs and the first event time, reading the log's own timestamp instead of the display time.

title: Splunk Investigation: Web Login Brute Force
summary: Investigated a brute-force attempt against a web admin login in Splunk, pivoting from the login requests to the source IP, the target server and the submitted form data, and noted a detection idea for it.

title: Writing Sigma Rules
summary: Went through a public Sigma rule for DNS tunneling field by field, then adapted it to a hypothetical C2 scenario: scoped the selection to one domain, lowered the threshold and updated the tags.

title: Installing Sysmon and Reading Endpoint Telemetry
summary: Installed Sysmon on a Windows 11 machine, traced my own nslookup through Event ID 1 and a hash check, then compared the default and a tuned config to see how the event mix changes.
